_note: Single source of truth linking stable keys to page paths. A page's key is its own config.json's location relative to assets/pages (e.g. 'attacker_lab' resolves to assets/pages/attacker_lab/config.json) and doubles as its Router navigation key - most pages need no entry here at all. This file only needs an entry when something else has to address a page by a friendlier or more stable name than its folder path: the startup page, a game mode's target workspace, or a lesson's target page plus its curriculum metadata.
